60	    kind := .lane
61	    boundary := some boundary
62	    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,

68	def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
69	  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
70	def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=

72	def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
73	def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=

105	def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=

116	    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
117	    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
118	    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
119	    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
120	    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
121	    pre ++ τ ++ post

133	/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
134	    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
135	    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
136	    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
137	    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the

139	    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back

142	  name : String
143	  rule : String
144	  trace : Trace
145	  reading : Reading
146	  manifest : Manifest
147	  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
148	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace

155	/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the

157	def pastOps : List String :=
158	  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
159	   "heading_since"]
160	
161	/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
162	    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
163	    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
164	    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
165	    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
166	    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
168	    `unknown` witness only.
169	    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
171	def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
172	  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
173	  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
174	    | some r => pure r
175	    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
176	  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
177	    | .ok S => pure S
178	    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
179	  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
180	    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
181	      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
182	  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
183	  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
184	  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
185	    match sc.window with
186	    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
187	    | none => true
188	  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
189	  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
190	    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
191	  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
192	    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"

194	  | .notApplicable =>
195	    if tl.present then pure got
196	    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
197	  | .unknown _ =>
198	    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
199	    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
200	    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
201	      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains

204	      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
205	    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
206	      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
207	    else pure got
208	  | _ => pure got
209	end Scenario

211	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

27	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
28	-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
29	-- square root at micrometre resolution).
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	namespace Geom
32	def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
33	def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
34	def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
35	/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
36	def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
37	def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
38	/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
39	def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
40	  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
41	  else
42	    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
43	    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
44	def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
45	/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
46	    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
47	    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
48	    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
49	    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
50	def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
51	  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
52	  if Q.isZero m then none
53	  else
54	    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
55	    let n := norm b
56	    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
57	/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
58	    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
59	def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
60	  let u ← unit h
61	  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
62	/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
63	def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
64	  let ab := vsub b a
65	  let ap := vsub p a
66	  let l2 := normSq ab
67	  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
68	  else
69	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
70	    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
71	/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
72	def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
73	  let n := poly.length
74	  if n < 3 then false
75	  else
76	    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
77	    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
78	      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
79	      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
80	        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
81	        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
82	         !Q.isZero dy &&
83	         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
84	    crossings.length % 2 == 1
85	/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
86	def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
87	  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
88	  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
89	/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
90	def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
91	  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
92	/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
93	def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
94	  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
95	  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
96	    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
97	/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
98	def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
99	  let n := poly.length
100	  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
101	/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
102	    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
103	def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
104	  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
105	    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
106	/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
107	def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
108	  match poly with
109	  | [] => none
110	  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
111	  | _ =>
112	    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
113	    else
114	      let n := poly.length
115	      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
116	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
117	/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
118	def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
119	  let ab := vsub b a
120	  let l2 := normSq ab
121	  if Q.isZero l2 then a
122	  else
123	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
124	    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
125	/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
126	def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
127	  match poly with
128	  | [] => none
129	  | [a] => some a
130	  | _ =>
131	    let n := poly.length
132	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
133	    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
134	      | none => some c
135	      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
136	/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
137	    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
138	def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
139	  match poly with
140	  | [] => []
141	  | [a] => [a]
142	  | _ =>
143	    let n := poly.length
144	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
145	    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
146	    | [] => []
147	    | d :: ds =>
148	      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
149	      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else
200	      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
201	      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
202	end Geom

275	-- Road structure and occupancy
276	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
277	/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
278	def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b
279	
280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind
286	
287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
294	def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
295	  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
296	  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
304	  else concrete k

307	def isKind (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=

324	  match st_lane_adjacency_left s r with
325	  | some n => some (n == r')
326	  | none => if st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r == some 1 then some false else none
327	/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its right: decided false for every

330	  match st_lane_adjacency_right s r with
331	  | some n => some (n == r')
332	  | none =>
333	    match st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r, st_lane_adjacency_count s r with
334	    | some o, some n => if o == n then some false else none
335	    | _, _ => none

339	/-- Whether line `l` marks carrier `a`'s entrance: decided where the line's entrances are observed,
340	    false for a region known to be neither a stop line nor a crosswalk, unknown otherwise. -/
341	def st_entrance_of (s : Scene) (l a : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
342	  (s.structure? l).bind fun st =>
343	    if st.entranceObserved then some (st.entranceOf.contains a)
344	    else match isKind s l .stopLine, isKind s l .crosswalk with

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]
412	
413	/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
415	    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
416	    to its reference point. -/
417	def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>
421	    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
424	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
425	  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

531	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
532	-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
533	-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
534	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
535	def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
536	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
537	  | some d => some d
538	  | none => do
539	    let pa ← kin_position s a
540	    let pb ← kin_position s b
541	    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))
542	
543	/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
544	private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
545	  let pa ← kin_position s a
546	  let pb ← kin_position s b
547	  let ha ← kin_heading s a
548	  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)
549	
550	/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
551	    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
552	    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
553	    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
554	    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
555	def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
556	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
557	  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
558	  | none => do
559	    let fa ← footprint s a
560	    let fb ← footprint s b
561	    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
562	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
563	    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
564	    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
565	def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
566	def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
567	/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
568	    or overlap, never negative. -/
569	def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm
570	
571	/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
572	    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
573	    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
574	def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
575	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
576	  | some v => some v
577	  | none => do
578	    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
579	    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
580	    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
581	    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
582	    else
583	      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
584	      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
585	      else if shared.contains none then none
586	      else some false
587	def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
588	def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a
589	
590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
592	    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
593	    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
594	def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
595	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
596	  | some v => some v
597	  | none => do
598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))
606	
607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)
622	
623	/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
624	def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
625	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
626	  | some v => some v
627	  | none => do
628	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
629	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
630	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
631	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
632	    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)
633	
634	/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
635	def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
636	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
637	  | some v => some v
638	  | none => relFrame s a b
639	def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
640	def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643	
644	/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
646	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
647	  | some v => some v
648	  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero
649	
650	/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
651	def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)
652	
653	end TrafficSpec
